$comment: `types: ["vite/client"]` and no "node" is deliberate. It removes the Node globals from the
renderer's scope entirely — `process`, `Buffer`, `require`, `__dirname` are not nameable, so
renderer code cannot reach for them by accident. CONTRACT §2.3 keeps the socket and the
token in main; this is the compile-time half of that guarantee, with the production CSP
noUncheckedIndexedAccess is deliberately NOT set here. The sphere writes into Float32Array
buffers in its hot loop, and the flag turns every typed-array read into `number | undefined`
— pure noise on a path that is bounds-checked by construction. It IS set for main/preload,
where the indexing is over parsed protocol data and the flag earns its keep.
